newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault, PSA fall on Nov sales.
newsitem.headline: Renault, PSA fall on Nov sales.

text.p: Shares in Renault SA and PSA Peugeot Citroen extended falls on Monday following November car sales figures which came in weaker than expected, a senior equity sales executive said.

"They were worse than expected," she said. Support for the stocks had already been weakened following newspaper reports that the car sector had been the worst hit by the truck drivers strike, and the sales data came as a further blow, she added.
Renault fell four percent to 119 francs at 1125 GMT, on volume of almost 90,000 shares. It has been down two percent earlier. PSA eased 1.25 percent to 634 francs.
Car sales in France fell 21.7 percent in November, the CCFA trade association said.
PSA sales fell 27 percent, while those of Renault were down 20.4 percent for the month. French carmakers took 55 percent of the domestic market and had 56.1 percent for the 11-month period.
